Ioannis 'Johnny' "JT" Theodosiou (born April 9, 1999) is a South African-Portuguese professional Counter-Strike 2 player and a former Counter-Strike: Global Offensive player.

  • 2021-04-29 | JT: "Now that we're in Europe we can tell that FaNg doesn't really feel the pressure like some other players would" by Nohte of HLTV at DreamHack Masters Spring 2021
  • 2021-05-27 | Extra Salt JT interview by Richard Lewis of Beyond The Summit at cs_summit 8
  • 2021-12-22 | Extra Salt’s JT thinks they can break into Tier 1 Counter-Strike in 2022 by Coby Zucker of Upcomer
  • 2022-04-11 | JT: "We think we're one of the strongest teams here and we want to prove that" by LucasAM of HLTV at PGL Major Antwerp 2022: American RMR
  • 2022-05-09 | JT: "After that first game the pressure is gone now” by Ryan Friend of Dust2.us at PGL Major Antwerp 2022
  • 2022-07-06 | JT: For most of us this has been the worst three months of our careers by Pley at Intel Extreme Masters XVII - Cologne
  • 2023-02-04 | JT on preseason prep: "I watched maybe 100+ demos" by Slevo of Dust2.us at Intel Extreme Masters Katowice 2023
  • 2023-04-11 | JT: "If I get zero kills and we win the map, I’m happy" by Ryan Friend of Dust2.us at BLAST.tv Paris Major 2023: American RMR
  • 2023-05-08 | JT: "We played very aggressive and I don't think they were expecting that" by Arnie of Dust2.us at BLAST.tv Paris Major 2023
  • 2023-05-31 | JT: "We didn't really have an answer for [Cloud9's] aggression" by Mnmzzz of Dust2.us at Intel Extreme Masters Dallas 2023
  • 2023-06-08 | JT: "For Sonic to come back and put up numbers is pretty impressive" by Striker of HLTV at BLAST Premier: Spring Final 2023
  • 2023-06-09 | JT: "I think a lot of us just need to put in a lot more work" by Draik04 of Dust2.us at BLAST Premier: Spring Final 2023
  • 2023-07-13 | JT on facing Vitality: "It's going to be be really good to see how close we are to them" by GoncOak of Dust2.us at BLAST Premier: Fall Groups 2023
  • 2023-10-20 | JT: "It's really easy to be creative in CS2 in terms of strategies" by Nohte of HLTV at Intel Extreme Masters Sydney 2023
  • 2023-12-16 | JT: "We know we're a little bit inconsistent right now" by Mnmzzz of Dust2.us at ESL Challenger at DreamHack Atlanta 2023
  • 2023-12-16 | COL JT: "We know we can beat any team, but we can also lose to any team" by Pedro Romero of BLIX.GG at ESL Challenger at DreamHack Atlanta 2023
  • 2024-01-17 | JT: "[Complexity] are still very inexperienced" of BLAST at BLAST Premier: Spring Groups 2024
  • 2024-03-04 | JT: "The format for this tournament was terrible" by Scoobster of Dust2.us at PGL Major Copenhagen 2024: American RMR
  • 2024-03-21 | JT on EliGE: "He's one of the best CS2 players in the world" by Ryan Friend of Dust2.us at PGL Major Copenhagen 2024
  • 2024-03-21 | Interview - JT by James Banks of PGL at PGL Major Copenhagen 2024
  • 2024-03-23 | JT on Vitality loss: "We're so close to making playoffs and we just let it go" by Ryan Friend of Dust2.us at PGL Major Copenhagen 2024
  • 2024-11-11 | JT: "Making the Major is still going to be very challenging for everyone" by Sumljiv_Model of HLTV at Perfect World Shanghai Major 2024: American RMR
  • 2025-01-31 | JT: "There are encouraging moments, but we don't have time to keep losing" by Striker of HLTV at Intel Extreme Masters Katowice 2025
  • 2025-02-15 | JT: "We need wins or we're going to start cratering in the rankings" by DOMINA7HOR of Dust2.us at PGL Cluj-Napoca 2025
  • 2025-04-06 | JT: "It feels good to finally be winning some games" by LucasAM of HLTV at PGL Bucharest 2025
  • 2025-04-11 | JT: "If Grim keeps it up, we can definitely keep winning" by DOMINA7HOR of Dust2.us at PGL Bucharest 2025
  • 2025-04-11 | JT: "We’re probably going to keep being the underdog" by James Banks of PGL at PGL Bucharest 2025
  • 2025-04-23 | JT: "It's going to take time to get to that [playoff] level consistently" by MIRAA of HLTV at Intel Extreme Masters Melbourne 2025
  • 2025-06-03 | JT: "Our team struggled to get into the game at the beginning and nicoodoz took full advantage of that" by Mnmzzz of Dust2.us at BLAST.tv Austin Major 2025
  • 2025-06-05 | JT: "If you can't get out of Stage 1 of the 32-team Major, you just basically don't deserve to be there" by Mnmzzz of Dust2.us at BLAST.tv Austin Major 2025
  • 2025-07-19 | JT: "I'd like to have gone further, but I'm happy that we're at least improving" by MIRAA of HLTV at FISSURE Playground #1
  • 2025-09-20 | JT: "It feels like we have been improving really fast, at least in practice" by King Dempz of HLTV at StarLadder StarSeries Fall 2025
  • 2025-12-02 | JT: "To win a tournament you have to be a bit delusional and think you're the best" by Roque Marques of Dust2.us at StarLadder Budapest Major 2025
  • 2025-12-05 | JT on T side struggles: "We've played really strong teams so far, and it's difficult to keep renewing" by MIRAA of HLTV at StarLadder Budapest Major 2025
  • 2026-04-26 | JT: "We don't even have three weeks of practice with Senzu, and it's been two and a half months" by Mnmzzz of Dust2.us at FRAG 20
  • 2026-05-12 | JT: "Right now we're kinda just in limbo" by Draik04 of HLTV at Intel Extreme Masters Atlanta 2026
  • 2026-07-29 | JT: "EliGE needs space and have his own voice to feel comfortable, and I'm always giving him that" by Sumljiv of HLTV at BLAST Bounty Summer 2026
